title: Cipher and Autopsy
author: Paloma Sterling
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
